name: What are the benefits of rerouting old, corroded pipes instead of just repairing leaks?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of rerouting old, corroded pipes instead of just repairing leaks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rerouting old, corroded pipes provides a long-term solution compared to patching individual leaks. While repairing a leak fixes an immediate problem, it doesn't address the underlying issue of widespread corrosion, which can lead to future leaks and ongoing maintenance costs. A key practical tradeoff is that rerouting offers improved water pressure, cleaner water quality, and enhanced system reliability, preventing recurring issues and providing peace of mind for many years. It is a more significant upfront investment but often reduces long-term plumbing expenses.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rerouting offers a long-term fix for widespread corrosion, providing better water pressure, cleaner water, and preventing future leaks.
